Product comps

Product·by @Swaraj524·2026-09-02·inspora page·original post

What it is

Static 4-slide set of polished dark-mode product UI comps (no motion): audio signal dashboard, CRM filters panel, command-K search palette, AI chat citation popover. The deliverable is pixel-faithful UI recreation.

Build prompt

Recreate 4 dark-mode product comps as static, pixel-clean UI slides. 1) Signal dashboard: near-black panel (corner reticle brackets), breadcrumb title 'Threshold / Signal strength', two giant percentage numerals with a small green delta chip, a yellow segmented bar (filled 0-56%, remaining as faint ticks) with 0/25/50/75/100% labels, and an 'ACTIVE CHANNELS' icon row + '4 INPUTS' olive chip. 2) Filters panel: 360px dark slide-over, search input with shortcut icon, grouped attribute rows (icon, label, grey count chip, chevron), hairline separators, close button; page behind heavily blurred. 3) Command palette: centered glass card (backdrop-blur, 1px white/10 border), search row with kbd chip, RECENT and ALL USERS sections with 40px avatar + green presence dot + name + email rows, footer with kbd hints. 4) Citation popover: article body with inline numbered citation chips; hovering a chip opens a near-black popover card with source title + external-link icon, '< 1 OF 2 >' pager, quoted excerpt, 'Page 14' ghost button and 'View source' primary button; below the answer, an outlined model-picker pill and 'Add to Knowledge Base' button. Type: 15-16px UI sans, 12px caps labels with letterspacing; radii 12-16px; borders white/8.
